title: Exploring the Transition from IPv4 to IPv6
summary: First-year network engineering students act as engineers for a multinational ISP and use GenAI plus authoritative sources to evaluate a full IPv4-to-IPv6 transition. Teams submit a process log, video presentation, and oral defense, with marks emphasizing critical validation and accountable AI use.

sources.title: GenAI-Empowered Group-Based Authentic Assessment for Network Engineering Courses
sources.evidence_quote: We designed a GenAI-empowered, group-based authentic assessment, titled Exploring the Transition from IPv4 to IPv6, which accounts for 30% of the course grade.

assessment.summary: Research the technical, economic, and social implications of IPv6 adoption and recommend a transition position to the Internet Engineering Steering Group.
student_actions: Form a team and assign project roles.
Use GenAI and authoritative sources to collect information.
Validate AI-generated information and document prompts and responses.
Develop and justify a consolidated recommendation.
Present and defend the recommendation in an oral examination.

inputs.description: Authoritative networking sources, including IETF material

student_role.description: Teams use GenAI for inquiry and alternative perspectives, then validate its relevance, accuracy, reliability, and possible hallucinations.

grading.method: Group rubric with peer adjustment for individual contribution.

criteria.criterion: Interim depth of discussion and prompt quality
Interim engagement with and critical evaluation of AI

process: Peer assessment adjusts the group mark to reflect individual effort.
Every member is expected to answer at least one panel question.
